title: Explain G-code: the one word table gives lathe posts mill meanings - G98/G99 read as cycle returns, T0101 as TOOL 101

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
**What happens.** `explain()` (`crates/post/src/post/explain.rs`, from #1394) explains every post's words from one table, `_EXPLAIN_WORDS`, keyed by the word alone. Two shipped lathe posts write words that mean something else on their control:

- `fanuc-lathe.cps` writes `G99` as feed per revolution (`onOpen`, line 368: `// unit, ZX plane, no nose comp, feed/rev`) and `G98` as feed per minute (C-axis live tooling, line 553). The table says G98 = `CYCLE RETURNS TO START HEIGHT`, G99 = `CYCLE RETURNS TO R HEIGHT`.
- `fanuc-lathe.cps` (line 428) and `tormach-lathe.cps` (line 383) write `T0101`: tool/station 1, offset 1. `_explainWord` reads the whole number: `TOOL 101`.
- `fanuc-lathe.cps` writes `G50 S<rpm>` as the spindle speed clamp (lines 432, 445, 458). G50 is not in the table, so the block is explained as `SPEED 3000` alone, which reads as a speed command.

**Reproduction** (main `38699549`). A test post that declares `explains = "paren"` and whose `block()` appends `explain(words)` (the shape `crates/post/tests/explain.rs` uses) was fed the blocks fanuc-lathe writes and posted through `engine::run_with` with `{"Explain": true}`:

```
G21 G18 G40 G80 G99 (MM UNITS, XZ PLANE, RADIUS COMP CANCEL, CANCEL DRILL CYCLE)
T0101 (TOOL 101)
G50 S3000 (SPEED 3000)
G96 S200 M3 (CONSTANT SURFACE SPEED, SPEED 200, SPINDLE ON CLOCKWISE)
G98 (CYCLE RETURNS TO START HEIGHT)
G99 (CYCLE RETURNS TO R HEIGHT)
G95 (FEED PER REVOLUTION)
G76 P010060 Q50 R0.02 (THREADING CYCLE)
```

Neighbour cases that read right: `G95` (tormach-lathe's feed per revolution) and `G76` (both lathes' threading cycle). On the mill posts `fanuc.cps` and `doosan-dnm.cps`, G99 does mean the R-plane return (#994).

**Reach today.** No shipped post declares `explains` yet, so no posted program carries these comments. #1388 names `fanuc-lathe.cps` and #1387 names `tormach-lathe.cps` among the posts that opt in next, so they would be the first to write them.

**Root cause (confirmed):** the meanings are one table keyed by word, with no way for a post to say what a word means on its control. The #1386 decision file sources the wording from RS-274 / ISO 6983 and the LinuxCNC lists, where G98/G99 are the canned-cycle returns. `_explainWord` also reads a `T` word as a single number.

**Done means:** a lathe post that opts into Explain never writes a mill meaning for G98/G99, never reads T0101 as tool 101, and never presents `G50 S` as a plain speed. One way: a post states its own meanings for the words its control reads differently, or the words to leave unexplained. Pin it with a test that posts G98, G99, G50 S and T0101 through fanuc-lathe with Explain on.

Suggested labels (an outside contributor cannot set them): `P7` while no lathe post explains (it becomes a misleading comment, `P3`, once #1387 or #1388 wires one), `effort:medium`, `area:post`, `source:agent`.
